_doc: Skill graph. tier: orchestrator | cross-cutting | lead | expert. consumes: contract IDs, a trailing '?' marks an optional dependency (feature degrades or is absent without it). profiles: 'all', 'client' (every configuration without the server base), or explicit profile tokens. runtime=true means the skill ships engine runtime code and implicitly consumes the 'runtime' universal contracts.

skills.name: Game Engine Chief Architect
skills.purpose: Owns the engine's overall architecture: requirements and configuration profiles, layering and module boundaries, the contract registry, global conventions, build/integrate/buy decisions and cross-domain arbitration. Final authority on the boundaries between skills.
non_responsibilities: Running the ADR, fitness-function and anti-legacy process
Scheduling work across agents and the ownership ledger
Architecture inside a domain (e.g. shading-path choice)

skills.name: Architecture Governance
skills.purpose: Runs architecture as an evidence-backed, governed process: ADR lifecycle with revisit conditions, technology radar with maturity tiers and promotion criteria, automated fitness functions (layering, dependency direction, contract conformance), anti-legacy review, coding standard.

skills.name: Engine Program Orchestration
skills.purpose: Turns architecture into coordinated multi-agent work: decomposes milestones into tasks by skill territory, keeps the ownership ledger and territory locks, sequences integration through vertical slices, routes contract change requests, and schedules critic gates.

skills.name: Research & Evidence
skills.purpose: Research discipline for every major decision: finds and grades authoritative evidence (production talks, platform docs, peer-reviewed work, reproducible benchmarks), classifies techniques as established / emerging / experimental / speculative, and runs spikes where literature is thin.
non_responsibilities: Making the decision (the owning skill does, via an ADR)

skills.name: Performance Architect
skills.purpose: Owns performance as a discipline: the hypothesis → instrumentation → measurement → optimization → regression-test loop, budgets per subsystem and hardware tier, the scalability / device-profile framework, and performance gates.
non_responsibilities: Optimizing a subsystem's code (its owner does, with review)

skills.name: Benchmarking & Performance Regression
skills.purpose: Benchmark harnesses (micro and representative-workload scenes), automated capture, statistical analysis (variance, significance), regression detection and bisection, dashboards.

skills.name: CPU Performance Engineering
skills.purpose: CPU microarchitecture-level optimization and review: cache and memory-access patterns, vectorization audits, contention and false sharing, hybrid-core and power-aware tuning, PGO/LTO.

skills.name: GPU Performance Engineering
skills.purpose: GPU performance analysis and review: occupancy, bandwidth, cache behavior, barrier and async-compute overlap, vendor tools across PC, console and mobile, GPU power.
expertise: GPU architecture (RDNA, Ada/Blackwell, Xe, Apple, Mali/Adreno)

skills.name: Loading & Hitch Performance
skills.purpose: End-to-end load time, startup time and hitch elimination (PSO compilation, streaming stalls, GC pauses, synchronous waits), IO throughput analysis.

skills.name: Test Architect
skills.purpose: Test strategy and architecture: per-subsystem test pyramid, frameworks, the test definition of done every skill must meet, contract tests, test content, coverage and mutation policy, flakiness policy.

skills.name: Rendering Validation
skills.purpose: Rendering correctness validation: golden-image tests with perceptual metrics, tolerances per GPU/driver, comparisons against the reference path tracer, graphics API validation in CI.
non_responsibilities: Material furnace tests (defines them; this skill runs them)

skills.name: Functional Automation & Soak
skills.purpose: Game-level automation: scripted and bot playthroughs, smoke/boot tests, soak and stability runs (memory growth, leaks), hardware/OS compatibility matrix, network harnesses and server load tests.

skills.name: Robustness & Fuzzing
skills.purpose: Robustness engineering: fuzzing every untrusted-input parser (assets, packets, saves, scripts, mods), sanitizer build policy, fault injection (IO errors, OOM, device lost), concurrency stress and schedule perturbation.

skills.name: Certification & Compliance
skills.purpose: Tracks and pre-validates external requirements: platform certification (TRC/XR/Lotcheck class), age ratings, privacy law, accessibility law (CVAA, EAA), third-party licenses and SBOM, photosensitivity testing.

skills.name: Security Engineering
skills.purpose: Threat modeling and trust boundaries for every untrusted input, secure-coding and memory-safety policy, supply-chain security, secrets, anti-tamper boundary, privacy engineering, mod/UGC sandbox policy.

skills.name: Anti-Cheat & Game Integrity
skills.purpose: Cheat resistance for online games: server-authoritative validation patterns (movement, hits, economy), rate limiting, anomaly signals, integration boundary for client anti-cheat middleware.

skills.name: Observability & Telemetry
skills.purpose: Instrumentation substrate: structured logging, trace zones (CPU, GPU, IO, memory), counters and metrics, profiler integrations, in-game stats, development and live telemetry with privacy consent; zero cost when compiled out.

skills.name: Crash & Hang Diagnostics
skills.purpose: Crash, hang and GPU-fault capture and reporting: minidumps, symbolication, bucketing and triage, GPU crash dumps, watchdogs, OOM reports, assert reporting.

skills.name: Determinism & Replay
skills.purpose: Defines determinism levels (none, same-binary, cross-platform) per subsystem and the floating-point and parallel-execution rules that achieve them; owns input/state record-replay and desync detection.

skills.name: Hot Reload & Iteration
skills.purpose: Owns the reload protocol (change detection, dependency invalidation, state preservation) that assets, shaders, scripts, config and C++ live coding plug into; measures edit → see latency.

skills.name: Accessibility
skills.purpose: Maps XAG/GAG and legal requirements to engine features and owns subtitles and captions, screen-reader/TTS/STT hooks, colorblind and contrast modes, text scaling, motion and photosensitivity options, assist hooks, and their validation.

skills.name: API Lifecycle & Engine Migration
skills.purpose: Public API surface, semantic versioning and deprecation, ABI policy, engine-upgrade tooling (codemods, data upgraders) and LTS policy, so projects can move across engine versions.

skills.name: Plugin System
skills.purpose: Plugin architecture: manifests, discovery, dependency resolution, load phases, binary vs source plugins, isolation, distribution format.

skills.name: Modding & UGC
skills.purpose: Mod and UGC support: mod SDK, content overrides via VFS layering, sandboxed mod scripting, UGC upload and moderation boundaries, mod compatibility across patches.

skills.name: Developer Experience & Documentation
skills.purpose: Documentation and developer experience: API reference, architecture docs, the sample-project ladder (2D → open-world online) that doubles as integration tests, templates, onboarding, doc testing, error-message standards, DX metrics.

skills.name: ML Inference Runtime
skills.purpose: Runtime neural-network inference shared by neural rendering, animation, audio and AI: GPU (cooperative-vector / tensor) and CPU backends, model packaging and quantization, scheduling within frame budgets, determinism characteristics.

skills.name: Core Runtime Architect
skills.purpose: Core runtime architecture: layering within core, module system and engine lifecycle (parallel boot, init graph, shutdown), configuration and cvars, error-handling and failure model, language and compiler feature policy.

skills.name: Math, SIMD & Numerics
skills.purpose: Math and numerics: SIMD linear algebra, geometry and intersection primitives, computational geometry, numerical robustness, mixed and double precision, deterministic math, RNG and noise, curves, quantized formats, SPMD kernels with ISA dispatch.

skills.name: Memory & Allocators
skills.purpose: Memory management: virtual memory, allocator families, thread-local and NUMA-aware allocation, tagging and attribution, budget enforcement mechanisms, fragmentation control, memory debugging, OOM policy, UMA accounting.

skills.name: Containers & Core Types
skills.purpose: Containers and core types: cache-friendly containers (open-addressing maps, inline and SoA containers, rings), strings and UTF-8, interned names, hashing, bit utilities, algorithms, explicit-ownership and view types.

skills.name: Concurrency Primitives
skills.purpose: Memory model and atomics, synchronization primitives, lock-free and wait-free structures, safe memory reclamation, thread-safety annotations and model checking; reviewer for concurrent code engine-wide.

skills.name: Job System & Task Graph
skills.purpose: Task-parallel execution: work-stealing scheduler, dependency task graphs, fibers and C++20 coroutines, priorities and QoS, heterogeneous-core and NUMA placement, IO/GPU completion integration, parallel algorithms, blocking policy.

skills.name: Frame Orchestration & Time
skills.purpose: The engine loop expressed as a task graph: frame pipelining across simulation, render and GPU, tick phases and sync points, fixed-step simulation with interpolation, time domains, latency and pacing control.

skills.name: Object Model & Identity
skills.purpose: Object-model strategy and identity: generational entity IDs, stable GUIDs, hard/soft/weak references, the hybrid-model policy stating which data lives in ECS vs services vs asset objects vs UI, events and messaging.

skills.name: ECS Runtime
skills.purpose: ECS: storage (archetype chunks or sparse sets, chosen by ADR), queries, change detection, structural changes and command buffers, system scheduling with access-conflict analysis, relationships, singletons, authoring → runtime baking, debugging.

skills.name: Reflection & Metadata
skills.purpose: Type registry, reflection generation (codegen now, C++26 static reflection when toolchains allow), attributes, the property system, script-binding substrate, dynamic invocation.

skills.name: Serialization & Schema Evolution
skills.purpose: Binary and text formats, schema evolution and upgraders, in-place loadable layouts, canonical deterministic serialization, portability, and validation of untrusted input.

skills.name: Platform Architect
skills.purpose: Platform abstraction layer and porting strategy: OS services, CPU/GPU capability discovery, windowing, process lifecycle, capability tiers, and evaluation of new targets (web, cloud streaming).

skills.name: Desktop & Handheld PC Platforms
skills.purpose: Windows, Linux, SteamOS and macOS integration: display modes, HDR and VRR capability, DPI, OS-specific IO and scheduling behavior, handheld-PC specifics, server host OS.

skills.name: Console Platforms
skills.purpose: Console-class integration from platform-holder documentation: OS and memory model (UMA), suspend/resume, multi-user model, devkit workflows, platform requirements feeding certification.

skills.name: Mobile & Portable Platforms
skills.purpose: iOS, Android and portable-console integration: app lifecycle, thermal and power adaptivity, tile-based GPU implications, storage and download-size constraints.

skills.name: Platform & Online Services
skills.purpose: Abstraction over first-party platform services and third-party online backends: identity and sign-in, achievements and presence, entitlements and store, cloud saves, matchmaking/lobby/session boundaries, remote config, moderation boundaries, media capture, crossplay identity.

skills.name: Input Actions
skills.purpose: Action-level input: mapping and context stacks, rebinding, buffering and latency accounting, local-multiplayer assignment, accessibility input options, UI navigation routing, per-device glyphs, recording and replay.

skills.name: Input Devices & Haptics
skills.purpose: Device layer: keyboard/mouse raw input, gamepads, touch and gestures, motion sensors, pen, hotplug and user pairing, haptics (rumble, HD haptics, adaptive triggers).

skills.name: XR Runtime
skills.purpose: XR integration: OpenXR, stereo/multiview rendering hooks, foveation, reprojection and latency, XR input and hand tracking, comfort and safety requirements.

skills.name: Content Pipeline Architect
skills.purpose: Asset identity and the content pipeline: asset registry and dependency graph, deterministic incremental per-platform cooking, the cook-step contract, derived-data cache and content-addressed store, distributed cooking, content validation.

skills.name: Asset Import & Interchange

skills.name: Asset Cook Processors
skills.purpose: Generic processors: texture processing and GPU texture-compression encoding, mesh optimization, hosting of collision and other domain builders under the cook contract.

skills.name: Resource & Streaming Architect
skills.purpose: Runtime resource model: handles and explicit lifetime, load requests with priority and deadline, dependency-aware loading, the streaming manager (budgets, eviction, prediction), fallbacks, no-stall loading.

skills.name: Async IO & Storage
skills.purpose: Async IO: io_uring, IOCP, DirectStorage and console backends, IO scheduling and queue depth, GPU decompression, memory-mapped IO, file-system abstraction, error handling.

skills.name: Package Formats & VFS
skills.purpose: Package/container format and chunking, codec selection, VFS mount layering (base, patch, DLC, mods), encryption and signing, install-chunk layout.

skills.name: World Architect
skills.purpose: World representation strategy (data-oriented, no universal scene graph), partitioning and streaming cells, streaming sources, HLOD strategy, simulation LOD and significance, large-world coordinate policy, level transitions, server-side world streaming.

skills.name: World Data Model
skills.purpose: World and level documents, prefabs with nested overrides and variants, data layers, one-file-per-object layout for collaboration, level instances.

skills.name: Transforms & Spatial Queries
skills.purpose: Transform representation and parallel hierarchy propagation, attachments, large-world coordinates implementation, generic spatial index and query service for non-physics consumers, spatial hashing.

skills.name: Terrain
skills.purpose: Terrain end-to-end: representation, rendering, material layering, sculpt/paint tool logic, runtime deformation, collision data hand-off.

skills.name: Vegetation & Foliage
skills.purpose: Vegetation instancing and rendering, procedural placement rules, wind and interaction, vegetation-specific LOD.

skills.name: Water & Ocean
skills.purpose: Ocean spectral simulation, rivers, lakes and shorelines, water surface rendering, water queries for buoyancy.

skills.name: Atmosphere, Volumetrics & Weather
skills.purpose: Sky and atmospheric scattering, volumetric clouds, volumetric fog and local media, weather state and surface response, time of day.

skills.name: Procedural Content Generation
skills.purpose: Deterministic graph-based PCG framework usable in editor and at stream-in, placement and scattering rules, grammar and constraint methods; evaluates ML generation.

skills.name: Render Architect
skills.purpose: Rendering architecture: pipeline organization, shading-path choice (forward+, deferred, visibility buffer), render-feature contract, render scene and world→render sync, scalability tiers from 2D mobile to path-traced, multi-view, debug modes, render threading.

skills.name: RHI Core
skills.purpose: Render hardware interface over D3D12, Vulkan, Metal, console APIs and WebGPU: queues and command recording, synchronization, bindless descriptors, PSOs and PSO caching, presentation, capability tiers, GPU crash breadcrumbs, driver workarounds.

skills.name: GPU Memory & Resources
skills.purpose: GPU heaps and suballocation, residency and overcommit, upload/readback rings, sparse/reserved resources, GPU memory budgeting and defragmentation, lifetimes decoupled from frame boundaries.

skills.name: Render Graph & GPU Scheduling
skills.purpose: Render graph declaration and compilation, automatic barriers, transient aliasing, async compute and multi-queue scheduling, TBDR pass merging, history resources, work-graph integration, general GPU compute, readback contract.

skills.name: Shader System
skills.purpose: Shading language and dialect, compilation toolchain, permutations, reflection and binding layouts, interop headers, caches and distributed compilation, hot reload, shader debugging, PSO-list gathering.

skills.name: Material System
skills.purpose: Material model (OpenPBR-class, layered), material graph → shader code generation, instances and parameters, quality tiers, material validation; evaluates neural materials.

skills.name: GPU-Driven Geometry Pipeline
skills.purpose: GPU scene and instance data, GPU frustum and two-phase occlusion culling, indirect and device-generated commands, mesh/amplification shaders, visibility-buffer rasterization, instancing, CPU-driven fallback for low-tier GPUs.

skills.name: Virtualized Geometry & LOD
skills.purpose: All geometric LOD: cluster hierarchies and virtualized geometry, cluster DAG building, software micro-polygon rasterization, cluster streaming, discrete LOD, HLOD proxies and impostors, deforming-geometry LOD, displacement.

skills.name: Textures & Virtual Texturing
skills.purpose: Runtime texture formats, mip streaming, sampler-feedback streaming, virtual texturing, streaming-friendly cooked layout; evaluates neural texture compression.

skills.name: Direct Lighting & Shadows
skills.purpose: Light types and physical units, clustered light culling, stochastic many-light sampling, area lights, cascaded, virtual and ray-traced shadows, contact shadows, light profiles.

skills.name: Global Illumination & Reflections
skills.purpose: Indirect lighting across tiers: baked lightmaps, probe volumes, screen-space GI and AO, surface/radiance-cache hybrid GI, ReSTIR GI, reflections, sky lighting, specular occlusion, SDF scene representations.

skills.name: Ray Tracing Infrastructure
skills.purpose: Acceleration structure management at scale, inline vs pipeline RT, opacity micromaps, RT LOD, software RT fallback, shader execution reordering, cluster/partitioned acceleration structures.

skills.name: Path Tracing
skills.purpose: Reference path tracer as ground-truth oracle for validation, real-time path tracing, offline cinematic render mode.

skills.name: Reconstruction, Upscaling & Denoising
skills.purpose: Temporal anti-aliasing and reconstruction, temporal and ML upscalers, frame generation, dynamic resolution, the motion-vector/jitter/history contract, spatiotemporal and ML denoising, variable-rate shading.

skills.name: Post-Processing, Color & HDR
skills.purpose: Post chain, physical camera and exposure, end-to-end color management (working space, output transforms, OCIO), HDR output and calibration, tonemapping, grading.

skills.name: Translucency & Decals
skills.purpose: Transparency and OIT, refraction and distortion, decals, translucent lighting and volumetric integration.

skills.name: Character Rendering
skills.purpose: Skin subsurface scattering, eyes, strand-based hair and fur rendering, digital-human LOD.

skills.name: 2D, Vector & UI Rendering
skills.purpose: 2D draw backend shared by 2D games, UI and debug overlays: sprites, tilemaps, 2D lighting, vector paths, UI batching/clipping/SDF, HDR compositing, pixel-perfect modes.

skills.name: Particles & VFX
skills.purpose: GPU particle simulation, VFX graph runtime, ribbons/beams/mesh particles, particle collision, VFX budgets and significance.

skills.name: Physics Architect
skills.purpose: Physics architecture: build vs integrate decision, physics world representation and ECS integration, stepping and frame sync, determinism levels, physics LOD, materials, GPU offload evaluation; covers both 2D and 3D.

skills.name: Collision Detection & Queries
skills.purpose: Shapes, broadphase, narrowphase and contact manifolds, CCD, scene queries, filtering, mesh/heightfield/SDF collision, collision cooking.

skills.name: Rigid-Body Dynamics
skills.purpose: Integration and constraint solvers, joints, islands and sleeping, parallel solving, stacking stability, kinematic and animated bodies.

skills.name: Character & Vehicle Physics
skills.purpose: Character controllers (kinematic and dynamic), vehicles (wheels, tires, suspension, drivetrain), buoyancy, moving platforms and physical interaction.

skills.name: Cloth & Deformables
skills.purpose: Cloth, soft bodies, ropes and cables, hair strand simulation; evaluates ML cloth.

skills.name: Destruction & Fracture
skills.purpose: Fracture authoring and precomputation, runtime fracture and debris, destruction replication strategy, propagation to navigation, rendering and audio.

skills.name: Fluid Simulation
skills.purpose: Particle fluids, grid smoke and fire, shallow-water simulation, GPU fluid solvers.

skills.name: 2D Physics
skills.purpose: 2D rigid bodies and collision, 2D character controllers, 2D determinism.

skills.name: Animation Architect
skills.purpose: Animation architecture: data model, parallel evaluation pipeline, animation/physics/gameplay sync and root-motion policy, animation LOD, budgets.

skills.name: Animation Runtime
skills.purpose: Sampling and decompression, compression, blending/layering/masks/additives, retargeting, curves and notifies, 2D skeletal and flipbook animation.

skills.name: Skinning & Deformation
skills.purpose: GPU skinning (linear, dual quaternion), morph targets, ML deformers, deformed-geometry acceleration-structure updates, deformation motion vectors.

skills.name: Animation Graphs
skills.purpose: Animation graphs and state machines, blend spaces, graph compilation and data-driven evaluation, graph debugging and rewind.

skills.name: Motion Synthesis

skills.name: IK, Procedural & Physical Animation
skills.purpose: IK solvers, foot placement, procedural animation, physical animation and active ragdoll.

skills.name: Facial Animation

skills.name: Cinematics & Sequencer
skills.purpose: Timeline/sequencer, camera cuts and cinematic cameras, high-quality movie rendering, cutscene streaming and preloading.

skills.name: Audio Architect
skills.purpose: Audio engine architecture and threading, device backends, voice management and virtualization, middleware decision, audio budgets.

skills.name: Audio DSP & Mixing
skills.purpose: Mixer graph and buses, DSP effects and convolution reverb, dynamics and loudness, codecs and decoding, audio streaming, procedural synthesis, voice-chat capture and processing.

skills.name: Spatial Audio & Acoustics
skills.purpose: Panning and distance, HRTF, ambisonics, object-based output, occlusion and obstruction, acoustic propagation, reverb environments.

skills.name: Audio Content Runtime
skills.purpose: Audio event system and parameters, interactive music, dialogue and VO, authoring tool integration, audio-to-haptics.

skills.name: Network Architect

skills.name: Network Transport

skills.name: Replication & State Sync
skills.purpose: Entity and property replication, delta compression and quantization, interest management, prioritization, RPCs, snapshot interpolation, replay recording, network ID mapping.

skills.name: Prediction, Rollback & Lag Compensation

skills.name: Dedicated Servers

skills.name: Gameplay Framework Architect
skills.purpose: Gameplay framework: rules, players and possession, extension points and game-module structure, game flow and transitions, local players.

skills.name: Gameplay Systems Toolkit
skills.purpose: Reusable gameplay systems: abilities, effects and attributes, gameplay tags, camera system, spawning and pooling, gameplay message routing, photo mode.

skills.name: Scripting Runtime

skills.name: Navigation & Pathfinding
skills.purpose: Navmesh generation (tiled, runtime rebuild), grid and hierarchical pathfinding, path following, off-mesh links, 3D/volumetric navigation.

skills.name: Crowd Simulation
skills.purpose: Flow fields, crowd avoidance, mass-agent simulation and LOD.

skills.name: AI Behavior & Perception
skills.purpose: Decision making (behavior trees, utility, HTN/GOAP, state trees), perception, environment queries, smart objects, AI scheduling and LOD; evaluates learned and LLM-driven agents.

skills.name: Persistence & Save Games
skills.purpose: Save-game model and serialization, save versioning and migration, atomic writes, platform save APIs and quotas, cloud-save sync, persistent world-state deltas, checkpoints.

skills.name: UI Architect
skills.purpose: UI architecture (retained with data binding for game UI, immediate for developer UI), layout, styling, focus and navigation, animation, in-world UI, designer tool logic, UI performance.

skills.name: Text & Fonts
skills.purpose: Font loading and fallback, glyph rasterization, shaping, bidi and line breaking, rich text and emoji, text input and IME.

skills.name: Editor UI Framework
